channel.title: Mural - daily ai journal
channel.description: The day's AI news, twelve front pages every morning at 7am (Sao Paulo).

item.title: OpenAI says agents leaked 53 images from ChatGPT users in latest example of rogue activity
item.description: Disclosure reveals ⁠new area of privacy risk for the company and illustrates ​how difficult it is to inventory unauthorized activity tied to its agents Two ⁠months after OpenAI disclosed the accidenta (The Guardian)

item.title: Papa Leão XIV alerta na França para risco de a IA criar um 'paraíso de máquinas'
item.description: Pontífice afirmou que é preciso preservar a humanidade diante do avanço da tecnologia e defendeu maior atenção ao uso ético da inteligência artificial. (g1)

item.title: Court rules Pentagon can blacklist Anthropic for refusing to enable Claude features
item.description: "Overly constrained AI models" could cause military operations to fail, judges say. (Ars Technica)

item.title: OpenAI bots meddled with multiple US government agency sites
item.description: OpenAI said its bots accessed public data from a range of institutions during test exercises. (BBC News)

item.title: At Meta Connect, the company’s smart glasses were everywhere
item.description: The company behind Facebook and Instagram wants to keep consumers connected to the digital world via its ever-growing line of smart glasses. (TechCrunch)

item.title: OpenAI hack on Australian government reveals anxiety at heart of global artificial intelligence dilemma
item.description: As the UN warns traditional safeguards are ‘unravelling’, Donald Trump says he will encourage, not restrain, the AI race When the Australian prime minister, Anthony Albanese, sat down for an interview (The Guardian)

item.title: Selo "feito por humano": negócios apostam na ausência de IA como diferencial de venda
item.description: Marcas e criadores começam a transformar a ausência de inteligência artificial em argumento de autenticidade diante da multiplicação de conteúdo automatizado (Exame)

item.title: Como manter o cérebro ativo na era da IA? Ciência aponta estratégias
item.description: Pesquisadores explicam como evitar a terceirização do raciocínio e preservar habilidades como memória, aprendizagem e pensamento crítico (Exame)

item.title: Microsoft thinks its new Copilot ‘super app’ will be as influential as Office
item.description: After teasing its new Copilot "super app" last month, Microsoft is officially unveiling it today. (The Verge)

item.title: US supreme court rejects Republican-drawn midterm map in Missouri for third time – as it happened
item.description: Long-running fight over Trump-backed maps takes another turn as absentee voting is already under way in Missouri. (The Guardian)

item.title: Resumo da semana: IA na ONU, Starship, novas IAs e lançamentos da Meta
item.description: Depois das discussões na ONU, Trump recebeu Xi e executivos tech na Casa Branca O post Resumo da semana: IA na ONU, Starship, novas IAs e lançamentos da Meta apareceu primeiro em Olhar Digital . (Olhar Digital)

item.title: Tesla workers balk at training Optimus humanoid robots as replacements
item.description: Despite challenges, Tesla aims for 1,000 Optimus robots per week by end of 2026. (Ars Technica)

item.title: Rogue OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website in world first
item.description: Australia criticised OpenAI for taking "too long" to tell them about the breach which happened in June. (BBC News)

item.title: Google is sending an AI satellite into space next week
item.description: Google is getting ready to launch a satellite with its AI processors to test how well they perform in space, as reported earlier by The New York Times. (The Verge)

item.title: 'Tamagotchi' com IA: como funciona o Muse Charm, novo dispositivo da Meta
item.description: Com o tamanho de um relógio de bolso e um personagem animado, Muse Charm lembra os antigos aparelhos que fizeram sucesso na década de 1990. (g1)

item.title: Google's first Suncatcher orbital data center test launches October 1
item.description: Google's experimental orbital data center will have four TPUs and only run for 15 minutes at a time. (Ars Technica)

item.title: Gemini can now call businesses for you so you don’t have to wait on hold
item.description: Google's launching an "early experiment" feature on Pixel 11 that lets users delegate local business calls to Gemini, like making a reservation, checking if a product is in stock, or rescheduling an… (The Verge)

item.title: PM rejects ‘nonsense’ suggestion he delayed revealing OpenAI Medicare hack as Labor considers changing laws
item.description: Expert says Australia’s criminal laws should be clarified to determine how fault is applied to a corporation when its AI agent commits a crime Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Ge (The Guardian)

item.title: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 vs. Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2: How these AI glasses compare
item.description: Meta's newest smart glasses are an iterative, expensive update. (Engadget)

item.title: Trump touts ‘great meeting’ with Xi at White House – as it happened
item.description: This blog is now closed – our live coverage of US politics continues here In the first row in front of the leaders sit US vice-president JD Vance and his wife Usha Vance, Trump’s daughter Ivanka Trump (The Guardian)

item.title: Trump diz que IA será grande tema de reunião com Xi Jinping
item.description: Líderes se reúnem na quinta-feira (24) para discussões, e chinês retorna a Pequim na sexta-feira (25), após cerimônia do chá oferecida por Melania Trump e visita ao Arquivo Nacional. (g1)

item.title: Parents and carers: how has your view on your children’s use of social media or AI changed?
item.description: Is the scrutiny tech firms are facing making you rethink your children’s relationship with technology? (The Guardian)

item.title: The Pentagon wants $30 million to build an AI-powered lie detector
item.description: The US government wants to spend $30.3 million over the next five years on an improved form of lie detector, according to a Department of Defense budget request. (MIT Technology Review)

item.title: Brasil tem capacidade de atrair investimento em IA, questão é como se posicionar, diz BlackRock
item.description: O Brasil tem capacidade de atrair investimentos relacionados à inteligência artificial , mas a questão é como se posicionar de uma forma mais competitiva, afirmou nesta quinta-feira (24) o presidente- (Folha de S.Paulo)

item.title: Meta made a Tamagotchi-like wearable for its Muse AI agent
item.description: The tiny hardware device creates another mobile home for its AI agent Muse. (TechCrunch)

item.title: Google is sending a teensy-tiny AI data center to space
item.description: It's an experiment to see how the chips hold up in the harsh vacuum of the cosmos. (Engadget)

item.title: Meta debuts no-camera smart glasses and virtual reality spectacles
item.description: The new wearables come at a time of uncertainty for smart glasses, which are facing backlash over privacy concerns Meta announced an advanced new set of virtual reality glasses and a collection of new (The Guardian)

item.title: Nick Clegg plays down fears ‘godlike’ AI could exterminate humanity
item.description: Former deputy PM now involved in tech industry says many within sector are ‘winding themselves up into a lather’ Nick Clegg has dismissed fears over AI’s “godlike power to exterminate humanity”, calli (The Guardian)

item.title: Líderes de IA discutem riscos da tecnologia em reunião do Conselho de Segurança da ONU
item.description: CEO da Anthropic afirmou que IA pode ser uma ameaça para a humanidade se for mal gerenciada. (g1)

item.title: Launch of UK’s ‘largest AI supercomputer’ delayed by power supply problems
item.description: Datacentre hailed by government was supposed to start operating next year but may be held back into mid-2030s A huge datacentre project hailed by the UK government will miss its launch date next year (The Guardian)

item.title: Inteligência artificial pode criar riscos jurídicos; entenda como LGPD e compliance entram
item.description: ANPD aponta desafios relacionados à IA generativa, como compartilhamento de dados, transparência e uso de informações pessoais (Exame)

item.title: Claude descobre novo sistema de enzimas
item.description: Inteligência artificial da Anthropic foi usada para analisar aproximadamente 200 mil enzimas com 950 agentes em 21 horas. (Tecnoblog)
